description: Waking a blocked TcpListener accept by connecting to its own address fails for the Tailscale IPv6 address on macOS: a self-connect to fd7a:... times out (IPv4 100.x works), so the accept thread and its listener stay bound and the next bind gets 'Address already in use' (flick-3d4c).
resolution: Never wake accept threads over the network: poll the listener and a UnixStream pair with platform::poll, close the write end to stop, then join.
